title: DOE SRT and NNSA Office of Secure Transportation move recovered UFO material between labs

tellings.quote: operations. The DOE and/NSA employ two other agencies I think are highly likely involved in UFO retrieval operations or passing recovered UFO materials between US national labs here in the continental United States.

plain: A Department of Energy security unit known by the initials SRT, and the Office of Secure Transportation, part of the agency that handles US nuclear weapons, may be the ones collecting crashed UFO material and moving it between US national laboratories. The researcher who goes by UAPGerb says on the show that he thinks these two are "highly likely involved in UFO retrieval operations". He calls it his own conclusion and names no source. If he is right, the government's handling of such material would run through its nuclear security system.
